svg.title: Three pasta observances in October, compared by evidence
svg.desc: National Pasta Month runs October 1 through 31, promoted every year since 2011 by a National Pasta Association consumer program (Pasta Fits until a 2021 rename to Share the Pasta): documented. National Pasta Day falls on the fixed date of October 17 every year; no primary source names who set that date, and National Day Calendar's own research page says the creator has not been identified: unverified. World Pasta Day falls on October 25, established at the first World Pasta Congress in Rome on October 25, 1995, and celebrated annually since 1998: documented. In 2026, October 17 also happens to be Sweetest Day, an unrelated 1921 Cleveland observance, since Sweetest Day floats to the third Saturday of the month.
svg.text: National Pasta Month: all of October
Documented: NPA consumer program since 2011 (Pasta Fits, renamed Share the Pasta in 2021)

text.tspan: In 2026 only, Oct 17 also lands on Sweetest Day
(the year's third Saturday), a separate, unrelated 1921 holiday

svg.text: Sources: ilovepasta.org and sharethepasta.org (National Pasta Association); nationaldaycalendar.com; worldpastaday.org
